payload.title: Learning: the site Cyclotron learns from link, suggestion and idea decisions and their reasons
payload.description:
Slice 4 of PPY-2e9064, tied to PPY-c6aced (votes must train the site's Cyclotron). Statistical rules from slices 1-3 stay in charge until a trained classifier beats them on held-out human decisions.
Design: the design comment on the epic PPY-2e9064 (copied to docs/idea-context-packs.md by S1.0).
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
